<script>
(function () {

  // Detects if a string looks like a real kick-off time vs a game clock ("02:30", "8:30")
  // Game clocks: short elapsed times, often appear alongside a non-zero score
  function looksLikeGameClock(timeStr, card) {
    // If matchDate already says 'live' via class AND score is non-zero, it's a game clock
    const dateEl = card && card.querySelector('.matchDate');
    if (dateEl && dateEl.classList.contains('live')) return true;
    // If time has no AM/PM and hours < 24 but score div shows non-zero, treat as game clock
    return false;
  }

  function parseMatchTime(timeStr) {
    if (!timeStr) return null;
    const now = new Date();
    let hours, minutes;
    timeStr = timeStr.trim().toUpperCase();

    if (timeStr.includes('AM') || timeStr.includes('PM')) {
      const spaceIdx = timeStr.lastIndexOf(' ');
      const modifier = timeStr.slice(spaceIdx + 1);
      const timePart = timeStr.slice(0, spaceIdx).trim();
      const colonIdx = timePart.indexOf(':');
      if (colonIdx === -1) return null;
      hours = parseInt(timePart.slice(0, colonIdx), 10);
      minutes = parseInt(timePart.slice(colonIdx + 1), 10);
      if (isNaN(hours) || isNaN(minutes)) return null;
      if (modifier === 'PM' && hours !== 12) hours += 12;
      if (modifier === 'AM' && hours === 12) hours = 0;
    } else {
      const colonIdx = timeStr.indexOf(':');
      if (colonIdx === -1) return null;
      hours = parseInt(timeStr.slice(0, colonIdx), 10);
      minutes = parseInt(timeStr.slice(colonIdx + 1), 10);
      if (isNaN(hours) || isNaN(minutes)) return null;
      // Only apply PM assumption for unambiguous afternoon hours (1-9)
      // Hours 0, 10-23 are taken as-is
      if (hours >= 1 && hours <= 9) hours += 12;
    }

    if (hours > 23 || minutes > 59) return null;
    return new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate(), hours, minutes);
  }

  function getMatchStatus(card) {
    const hourElem = card.querySelector('.matchHour');
    const dateEl   = card.querySelector('.matchDate');
    const scoreEl  = card.querySelector('.natej');

    if (!hourElem) return 'upcoming';

    const rawTime = (hourElem.textContent || '').trim();

    // ── LIVE DETECTION ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    // If matchDate already carries class 'live' (set by your score widget),
    // AND the value looks like a game clock (no AM/PM, small number),
    // trust it as live — don't re-parse it as a start time.
    if (dateEl && dateEl.classList.contains('live')) {
      // Verify it's not a real time format with AM/PM
      const upper = rawTime.toUpperCase();
      if (!upper.includes('AM') && !upper.includes('PM')) {
        // Check if it looks like a game clock: "8:30", "02:30", "45+2", "HT"
        const parsed = parseFloat(rawTime);
        if (isNaN(parsed) || parsed < 24) {
          // It's a game clock or already-live marker — keep as live
          return 'live';
        }
      }
    }

    // ── NORMAL TIME-BASED STATUS ─────────────────────────────────────
    const start = parseMatchTime(rawTime);
    if (!start) return 'upcoming'; // unparseable → show as upcoming

    const diff = (start - Date.now()) / 60000; // minutes

    if (diff <= 0 && diff > -105) return 'live';   // within 105 min of start
    if (diff > 0  && diff <= 60)  return 'about';  // starts in next 60 min
    if (diff > 60)                return 'upcoming';
    return 'ended';
  }

  const SORT  = { live: 0, about: 1, upcoming: 2, ended: 3 };
  const LABEL = { live: 'LIVE', about: 'About to start', upcoming: 'Upcoming', ended: 'Ended' };
  const CLS   = { live: 'live', about: 'upcoming', upcoming: 'upcoming', ended: 'end' };

  function updateMatchCard(card) {
    const hourElem = card.querySelector('.matchHour');
    if (!hourElem) return;

    const status = getMatchStatus(card);

    // Always write sortStatus (never leave it as NaN/undefined)
    card.dataset.sortStatus = String(SORT[status]);

    // Update badge
    const statusDiv = card.querySelector('.matchDate');
    if (statusDiv) {
      statusDiv.textContent = LABEL[status];
      // Reset all possible classes then apply correct one
      statusDiv.className = 'matchDate ' + CLS[status];
    }

    // Play button
    const centerCol = card.querySelector('.Nateja');
    let playBtn = card.querySelector('.playBtn');
    if ((status === 'live' || status === 'about') && centerCol) {
      if (!playBtn) {
        playBtn = document.createElement('button');
        playBtn.className = 'playBtn';
        playBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Watch live');
        playBtn.title = 'Watch live';
        playBtn.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg>';
        playBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          const link = card.querySelector('a');
          if (link) window.location.href = link.href;
        });
        centerCol.appendChild(playBtn);
      }
    } else if (playBtn) {
      playBtn.remove();
    }
  }

  function sortCards(container) {
    const cards = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('.containerMatch'));
    cards.sort((a, b) => {
      const sa = Number(a.dataset.sortStatus ?? 99);
      const sb = Number(b.dataset.sortStatus ?? 99);
      const sd = sa - sb;
      if (sd !== 0) return sd;
      // Secondary sort: by start time
      const ta = parseMatchTime((a.querySelector('.matchHour') || {}).textContent || '');
      const tb = parseMatchTime((b.querySelector('.matchHour') || {}).textContent || '');
      if (!ta || !tb) return 0;
      return ta - tb;
    });
    const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    cards.forEach(c => frag.appendChild(c));
    container.appendChild(frag);
  }

  function refreshMatches() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.s803-matches').forEach(container => {
      container.querySelectorAll('.containerMatch').forEach(updateMatchCard);
      sortCards(container);
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', refreshMatches);
  } else {
    refreshMatches();
  }

  setInterval(refreshMatches, 60000);

})();
</script>
